request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBTRN02C-002: Reject transaction whose cross-referenced account does not exist

### given[0]: The card cross-reference lookup succeeded, so the fail reason is still 0.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['0']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   368            END-IF
   369            EXIT.
   370        1500-VALIDATE-TRAN.
   371            PERFORM 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF.
>> 372            IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 373               PERFORM 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT
   374            ELSE
   375               CONTINUE
   376            END-IF
   377       * ADD MORE VALIDATIONS HERE

### given[1]: The account file is read using the account ID from the cross-reference record as the key.
fields=['XREF-ACCT-ID', 'FD-ACCT-ID', 'ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   390                   CONTINUE
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
>> 394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
   396               INVALID KEY
   397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC

### when[0]: No account record exists for that account ID (INVALID KEY on the read).
fields=['ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 396               INVALID KEY
   397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY

### then[0]: The fail reason is set to 101.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['101']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
   396               INVALID KEY
>> 397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT

### then[1]: The reason description is set to 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
   396               INVALID KEY
   397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT

### then[2]: The credit-limit and expiration checks are not run. They only run when the account record is found.
fields=[] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   396               INVALID KEY
   397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 400               NOT INVALID KEY
>> 401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
>> 402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
>> 415                   CONTINUE
>> 416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 420                 END-IF
>> 421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   424        2000-POST-TRANSACTION.
   425            MOVE  DALYTRAN-ID            TO    TRAN-ID

### then[3]: The transaction is not posted. The reject count goes up by 1 and a reject record is written.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['0', '1']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
>> 213                      ELSE
>> 214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
>> 216                      END-IF
   217                    END-IF
   218                END-IF
   219            END-PERFORM.
   220

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 372-373 run 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT only when WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0 after the xref lookup, which matches the clause."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 394 moves XREF-ACCT-ID into the key FD-ACCT-ID, and line 395 reads ACCOUNT-FILE into ACCOUNT-RECORD."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 395-396 show the READ with an INVALID KEY branch, which is taken when no record exists for the key."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 397, inside the INVALID KEY branch, moves 101 to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 398-399 move 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 400-421 place the credit-limit and expiration checks under NOT INVALID KEY, so they run only when the record is found."},{"clause":"then[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 211-216 show that a nonzero fail reason skips 2000-POST-TRANSACTION, adds 1 to WS-REJECT-COUNT and performs 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC."}]}
